title: Metaphor as Coupling Medium — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Metaphor as Coupling Medium's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11, third batch: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. A challenger has now read this piece (2026-11-11); its verdict is in the section's challenge block. It was made before the challenge of the first forty came back (16 keep, 24 remake), so it likely carries the same kinds of fault that challenge found: a caption that reads more into the page than the page says, a 'what is real' line that owns too little, a count off by one where a parser was naive. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it. The challenger's verdict on this piece is retire. It was dropped on 2026-11-11 under Enrichment step 6 and put back the same day, unchanged, on Loudon's "I am happy with what we have": it stands as a proposal with the verdict beside it, uncommitted.

pieces.title: Eleven bridges
pieces.caption: Each of the eleven cross-domain pages, its avatar sitting between the two things it holds together: Compression and Intimacy, Cooking and Mixing, and so on down. *What is real and what is a choice:* The pages and their avatars are real. Reading each one as a coupling is this page's claim, applied to them. *Leaking in:* All eleven Cross-Domain Resonances pages.
